faq_heading: Homes near Crescent Heights Academy: your questions answered

faq.q: Does living near Crescent Heights Academy get a child a place?
faq.a: No. Crescent Heights Academy is an independent school and sets its own admission, so distance does not decide it. Ask the school how applications and wait lists work.

faq.q: How does the Crescent Heights Academy home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Crescent Heights Academy. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Crescent Heights Academy sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 713 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,275,000, townhomes $740,000, condos $448,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Crescent Heights Academy?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Crescent Heights Academy the median was 22 days on the market, closing at 97.3% of the list price, with 5% of sales above the list price for the 713 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Crescent Heights Academy?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Langley Meadows Elementary (0.7 km east), Katzie Elementary (1.1 km north) and Latimer Road Elementary (1.1 km south-west).

Crescent Heights Academy is an independent school in Surrey, at 19533 64 Avenue. It teaches kindergarten to grade 12.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Crescent Heights Academy, followed by what homes within 2 km of the school sold for.
How the Crescent Heights Academy search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Crescent Heights Academy, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of Crescent Heights Academy sold for

Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 713 homes sold within 2 km of Crescent Heights Academy: 225 houses, 310 townhomes and 173 condos. The largest group was townhomes, at a median of $740,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Crescent Heights Academy

19 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Crescent Heights Academy in a straight line (14 elementary, 4 secondary, 1 other; 2 independent). The closest is Langley Meadows Elementary, 0.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is Douglas Park Community, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Clayton Heights Secondary (1.8 km); the nearest independent school is Bibleway Christian Academy (1.9 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Sunrise Ridge Elementary (1.9 km). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-12) is Bibleway Christian Academy, 1.9 km south-west of Crescent Heights Academy.
